Return period: EU/UK customers have a 14-day statutory withdrawal right (return must be registered within 14 days, then handed to the carrier within another 14 days). All customers also have a 30-day voluntary return right from receipt; items must be unused, complete, and in original packaging.
How to return: Always register your return via our Return Portal first. Then you can:
Use our prepaid return label (a fee may be deducted depending on your country),
Ship with a carrier of your choice at your own cost, or
Return for free in person at one of our Flagship Stores (for online orders; store purchases must be returned in-store).
Exchanges: Direct exchanges are not possible. Please return the item and place a new order.
Refunds:
Issued to the original payment method after the return arrives and is inspected.
Processing can take up to 8 business days from arrival at our warehouse (and may be a bit longer in busy periods).
If you return your entire order, we also refund the cost of the cheapest standard shipping; if you keep at least one item, original shipping costs are not refunded.
